build_transformer_from_pretrained_xlm_mo: build a transformer model initialized from a pretrained XLM checkpoint for encoder and decoder
build_transformer_encoder_from_xlm: build a transformer encoder initialized with pretrained XLM weights and embeddings
build_transformer_decoder_from_xlm: build a transformer decoder initialized with pretrained XLM weights and embeddings
upgrade_state_dict_with_xlm_weights: upgrade a transformer state dict by loading pretrained XLM checkpoint weights into it
add_transformer_xlm_args: add command line arguments for pretrained XLM checkpoint path and encoder or decoder init flags
